Mastermind.classification: CodeQL security findings in PR test/evidence/harness material plus missing Rust configuration; substantive unresolved review gate, not only external policy
source_assessment: Two Bad HTML filtering regexp annotations hit script-extraction test code (live test and archived preimage). That code reads the local owned page, extracts its script with matchAll, and evaluates it in a test VM; it is not a production HTML sanitizer.
Incomplete HTML attribute sanitization annotation hits an archived market_view.html preimage at statusPill; current app/static/market_view.html is not one of the six annotated paths.

Three uncontrolled-path annotations hit the loopback harness. It resolves candidate and root, rejects paths outside root, requires is_file and a suffix allowlist, and binds 127.0.0.1. The annotations alone do not demonstrate bypass; no exploit test was run.
Missing /language:rust configuration warning coexists with an in-progress Rust analyzer at the snapshot; incomplete run cannot be assumed to resolve security annotations.
recommendations_for_owner_not_executed: Improve test extraction robustness, e.g. case-insensitive script matching, then targeted renderer test.
Prefer an enumerated static-asset allowlist/lookup built from trusted root rather than constructing a path from request input, if changing the diagnostic harness.

Preserve archived preimage bytes and hashes; if reclassifying as inert historical snapshots, use explicit non-executable snapshot filenames with manifest and reference updates, and document why. Do not edit historical bytes or disable CodeQL globally to silence alerts.
Review any remaining scanner findings through the existing security/CI owner and exact-head process; no dismissal or exemption authorized by this audit.
